items.title: Results posted for a study of Active Colchicine for Atrial Fibrillation
items.summary: Population Health Research Institute ran this final-stage test (phase 3) with 3,209 people. The registry lists its end date as 23 Jun 2023. The study team posted its results on ClinicalTrials.gov. A journal article that mentions this study is listed on PubMed and Europe PMC. It may not report these results. We don’t say here whether the treatment worked. The official study record has the full results.

items.title: Results posted for a study of NKTR-255 at 1.5 µg/kg for Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma
items.summary: Nektar Therapeutics ran this combined mid-stage and final-stage test (phase 2/3) with 15 people. It was stopped early. The study team’s reason: “Sponsor decided to end the study”. The registry lists its end date as 16 Aug 2024. The study team posted its results on ClinicalTrials.gov. Our search of PubMed and Europe PMC for this study’s number (NCT05664217) found no journal article. Searches can miss articles, so one may already exist. We don’t say here whether the treatment worked. The official study record has the full results.

items.title: A study of Pelacarsen for Acute Coronary Syndrome (ACS) was cancelled before it began
items.summary: Novartis Pharmaceuticals planned this final-stage test (phase 3). The study team’s reason: “Study terminated by sponsor following the outcome of the Lp(a)HORIZON study (NCT04023552), which did not meet its primary endpoint”. The registry doesn’t say when it was cancelled. The date above is when its record was last updated.

items.title: A study of Tapinarof cream for Atopic Dermatitis is paused
items.summary: Organon and Co leads this final-stage test (phase 3). The study team’s reason: “As a precaution, study drug dosing is paused due to a PK finding in OG505-3104. No safety signal or change to the established safety or benefit-risk profile has been identified. The Sponsor is further investigating and assessing the data”. It may start again. The registry doesn’t say when it was paused. The date above is when its record was last updated.

items.title: A study of INZ-701 for Ectonucleotide Pyrophosphatase/Phosphodiesterase1 Deficiency was stopped early
items.summary: Inozyme Pharma ran this final-stage test (phase 3) with 27 people. The study team’s reason: “The study was terminated by the sponsor prior to planned completion based on a review of the data across indications and overall program considerations. Study termination was not related to participant safety”. The registry lists its end date as 19 Aug 2026.

items.title: A study of Poziotinib for NSCLC is paused
items.summary: Spectrum Pharmaceuticals, Inc leads this final-stage test (phase 3). The study team’s reason: “The study has not enrolled any patients. The study design is under discussion and will likely be redesigned in consultation with the FDA”. It may start again. The registry doesn’t say when it was paused. The date above is when its record was last updated.

items.title: A study of INZ-701 for Ectonucleotide Pyrophosphatase/phosphodiesterase1 Deficiency was stopped early
items.summary: Inozyme Pharma ran this final-stage test (phase 3) with 2 people. The study team’s reason: “Following review of the totality of program data, the sponsor decided to discontinue development of INZ701. The decision was not related to safety”. The registry lists its end date as 31 Aug 2026.
